abilities.name: 生存意志
abilities.desc: 立即移除所有昏迷效果。
abilities.descEn: Removes all stun effects.

abilities.name: 感知
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 20秒
abilities.desc: 提高潜行侦测能力，持续20秒。
abilities.descEn: Increases your stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: 无情
abilities.desc: 使你的所有法术和攻击造成爆击的几率提高2%。
abilities.descEn: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.

abilities.name: 人类精魂
abilities.desc: 精神提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Increases Spirit by 5%.

abilities.name: 石像形态
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 8秒
abilities.desc: 立即移除并免疫所有流血、中毒和疾病效果，并使受到的所有物理伤害降低10%，持续8秒。
abilities.descEn: Removes bleed, poison, and disease effects and reduces physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: 寻找财宝
abilities.desc: 使矮人可以感知附近宝藏的位置，并将其显示在微缩地图上，持续。
abilities.descEn: Lets you sense nearby treasure and see it on the minimap.

abilities.name: 大地之怒
abilities.desc: 使你的爆击伤害和治疗加成提高2%。
abilities.descEn: Increases critical damage and critical healing by 2%.

abilities.name: 王牌猎人
abilities.desc: 对野兽造成的伤害提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Increases damage dealt to beasts by 5%.

abilities.name: 艾露恩之光
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 15秒
abilities.desc: 使你的所有法术和攻击的爆击几率提高10%，持续15秒。
abilities.descEn: Increases critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: 影遁
abilities.desc: 激活后潜入暗影之中，降低敌人发现你的几率。持续直到取消或移动。在战斗中使用此技能会降低敌人攻击你的意愿，但冷却时间延长至2分钟。
abilities.descEn: Puts you in stealth, reducing the chance enemies detect you. Lasts until cancelled or movement. Using it in combat lowers enemy aggression but extends the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: 迅捷
abilities.desc: 躲闪几率提高1%，移动速度提高2%。暗夜精灵潜行者和德鲁伊在潜行时更难被发现，效果相当于潜行等级提高1级。
abilities.descEn: Increases dodge by 1% and movement speed by 2%. Night elf rogues and druids are harder to detect while stealthed, equal to +1 stealth level.

abilities.name: 精灵之魂
abilities.desc: 死后变成小精灵，移动速度提高75%。
abilities.descEn: Become a wisp when dead, increasing movement speed by 75%.

abilities.name: 逃命专家
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 2分钟冷却 | 持续 3秒
abilities.desc: 立即摆脱任何限制移动效果的影响，并对这些效果免疫，持续3秒。
abilities.descEn: Removes movement-impairing effects and makes you immune to them for 3 sec.

abilities.name: 我知道了！
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 2分钟冷却 | 持续 15秒
abilities.desc:
潜行者：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的能量减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
术士：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的法力值减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
牧师：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的法力值减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
abilities.descEn: Rogue: non-periodic damage abilities cost 10% less energy and deal 10% more damage. Warlock: non-periodic damage abilities cost 10% less mana and deal 10% more damage. Priest: non-periodic damage abilities cost 10% less mana and deal 10% more damage.

abilities.name: 开阔思维
abilities.desc:
牧师、法师、术士：最大法力值提高5%。
潜行者：最大能量值提高5%。
战士：最大怒气值提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Priest, Mage, Warlock: maximum mana +5%. Rogue: maximum energy +5%. Warrior: maximum rage +5%.

abilities.name: 工程学专精
abilities.desc: 你的侏儒才智使你在使用工程学装置时出现故障或发生反冲的几率降低20%。
abilities.descEn: Reduces the chance of malfunction or backlash when using engineering devices by 20%.

abilities.name: 踏空而行
abilities.desc: 在半空中滑翔下降，持续10秒，并可控制移动方向。
abilities.descEn: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec, steering as you fall.

abilities.name: 阅读魔网
abilities.desc: 尝试引动附近魔网的力量，使生命与法力恢复速度提高100%。若附近没有魔网，持续15秒；若有，则持续15分钟。
abilities.descEn: Draw on nearby ley lines, increasing health and mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 15 sec without a ley line nearby, or 15 min with one.

abilities.name: 风灵护佑
abilities.desc: 法术、近战和远程急速提高3%。
abilities.descEn: Increases spell, melee, and ranged haste by 3%.

abilities.name: 元素洞察
abilities.desc: 对元素生物造成的伤害提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Increases damage dealt to elemental creatures by 5%.

abilities.name: 血性狂暴
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 2分钟冷却 | 持续 15秒
abilities.desc: 攻击强度和法术强度提高10%，持续15秒。
abilities.descEn: Increases attack power and spell power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: 粉碎诅咒
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 8秒
abilities.desc: 立即移除并免疫所有诅咒和灾祸效果，受到的所有魔法伤害降低5%，持续8秒。
abilities.descEn: Removes all curse and doom effects and reduces magic damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: 残暴
abilities.desc: 使你的所有法术和技能造成爆击的几率提高1%。
abilities.descEn: Increases critical strike chance with spells and abilities by 1%.

abilities.name: 坚韧
abilities.desc: 使你受到的昏迷效果持续时间缩短20%。
abilities.descEn: Reduces the duration of stun effects by 20%.

abilities.name: 被遗忘者的意志
abilities.desc: 立即移除所有魅惑、恐惧和催眠效果。
abilities.descEn: Removes charm, fear, and sleep effects.

abilities.name: 食尸
abilities.desc: 激活之后，每2秒回复总生命值的7%和总法力值的7%，持续10秒。只能对半径5码范围内的人型生物或亡灵的尸体使用。在食尸时进行移动、做出任何动作或受到任何伤害都会中断效果。
abilities.descEn: Restores 7% health and 7% mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only usable on humanoid or undead corpses within 5 yd. Moving, acting, or taking damage cancels it.

abilities.name: 水下呼吸
abilities.desc: 在水下呼吸的时间延长300%。
abilities.descEn: Increases underwater breath by 300%.

abilities.name: 哀伤之触
abilities.desc:
战士、圣骑士、潜行者：你的法术和攻击有20%的几率吸取目标生命值，最多相当于你最大生命值的5%。
牧师、法师、术士：你的法术和攻击有30%的几率吸取目标生命值，最多相当于你最大生命值的5%。
abilities.descEn: Warrior, Paladin, Rogue: spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain life, up to 5% of max health. Priest, Mage, Warlock: 30% chance, up to 5% of max health.

abilities.name: 战争践踏
abilities.desc: 使身边半径8码范围内的最多5个敌人昏迷，持续2秒。
abilities.infoEn: 0.5 sec cast · 2 min cooldown · 2 sec duration
abilities.descEn: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yd for 2 sec.

abilities.name: 栽培
abilities.desc: 栽培附近的一株草药，生长出一株无需草药学技能即可采集的复制品。每株草药只能栽培一次。
abilities.descEn: Cultivates a nearby herb, growing a copy that can be gathered without Herbalism. Each herb can only be cultivated once.

abilities.name: 原野疾驰
abilities.desc: 移动时每5秒使移动速度提高1%，最高可提高30%。受到伤害或站立不动会降低此效果。
abilities.descEn: While moving, gain 1% movement speed every 5 sec, up to 30%. Taking damage or standing still reduces the effect.

abilities.name: 耐久
abilities.desc: 总生命值提高5%，爆击伤害和治疗加成提高2%。
abilities.descEn: Increases total health by 5% and critical damage and healing by 2%.

abilities.name: 狂暴
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 10秒
abilities.desc: 使你的施法和攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。
abilities.descEn: Increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: 极速再生
abilities.info: 瞬发 | 3分钟冷却 | 持续 6秒
abilities.desc: 在6秒内恢复最大生命值的50%。任何移动、动作或受到伤害都会取消该效果。
abilities.descEn: Restores 50% of maximum health over 6 sec. Moving, acting, or taking damage cancels it.

abilities.name: 野兽杀手
abilities.desc: 对野兽的伤害提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Increases damage dealt to beasts by 5%.

abilities.name: 再生
abilities.desc: 生命值回复速度提高20%，在战斗中仍可保持20%的生命值回复速度。
abilities.descEn: Increases health regeneration by 20%, and keeps 20% regeneration in combat.

abilities.name: 踏空而行
abilities.desc: 在半空中滑翔下降，持续10秒，并可控制移动方向。
abilities.descEn: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec, steering as you fall.

abilities.name: 天穹视界
abilities.desc: 尝试汲取元素交汇处的力量以获取祝福，使移动速度和骑乘速度提高10%。若附近没有元素交汇处，持续30秒；若有，则持续15分钟。
abilities.descEn: Draw on a nearby elemental confluence for a blessing, increasing movement and mount speed by 10%. Lasts 30 sec without a confluence, or 15 min with one.

abilities.name: 风灵护佑
abilities.desc: 法术、近战和远程急速提高3%。
abilities.descEn: Increases spell, melee, and ranged haste by 3%.

abilities.name: 元素洞察
abilities.desc: 对元素生物造成的伤害提高5%。
abilities.descEn: Increases damage dealt to elemental creatures by 5%.
